design_principle: neutral publication canvas with sparse semantic RGB accents

semantic_roles.sector_power: red RGB channel; physical power-system structure
semantic_roles.sector_transportation: green RGB channel; physical transportation structure
semantic_roles.sector_information: blue RGB channel; sensing, estimation and communication
semantic_roles.sector_organization: amber; coordination, procedure and organizational action
semantic_roles.viable: green; sustainable, admissible, operational or recovery state
semantic_roles.critical: red; constraint, disturbance, critical boundary or propagation
semantic_roles.causal_control: ochre/gold; causal interface, mechanism or engineering intervention
semantic_roles.mathematical_model: violet; mathematical abstraction when a separate model cue is needed
semantic_roles.inference_data: cyan; observation, inference or data-mediated state information

color_redundancy.power: red + POWER label + physical solid-line topology + node geometry
color_redundancy.transportation: green + TRANSPORTATION label + physical solid-line topology + node geometry
color_redundancy.information: blue + INFORMATION label + dashed relation when used as an edge
color_redundancy.organization: amber + ORGANIZATION label + dotted relation when used as an edge
color_redundancy.operational: green + directional dash pattern + explicit viable/service label
color_redundancy.critical: red + dashed critical overlay + explicit boundary/critical label
color_redundancy.causal: gold/ochre + interface geometry + dashed/double stroke + explicit mechanism label

scientific_boundary: RGB defines visual appearance and semantic channels; scientific meaning never depends on color alone and color does not strengthen the evidence class of a claim.
